You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26729, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone: read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` and `ui/AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26729" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26729` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26729 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6447101712, verbatim: "the Lifecycle field picker refuses a Studio-authored select because its options need `kind`, and the options editor has no `kind` control. Add the control for the published option `kind` (#23809). … Re-check the landing site on current `main`." No maintainer ruling on the card.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

- On `origin/main` `4b59358a`, the picklist option editor in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` owns `value` / `label` / `color` (the `Option` docblock ≈L99–L130) and carries every other authored key, `kind` included, through `rest` untouched. So a `kind` that already exists survives, but nothing can author one. The spec declares `kind: 'open'|'won'|'lost'`, optional, "Required on every option of the field an object's `stageField` names. Only on a single-value `select` / `radio` field" (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` ≈L465). The refusal comes from the engine check at ≈L2539.
- So the likely fix promotes `kind` to an owned key with a control (open / won / lost, absent reading as open) on single-value select/radio fields. `readOptions`, `patchOptions` and the `Option` type move together, as the docblock requires. A written option never carries a `kind` on a field type the spec refuses it on.
- The Lifecycle picker (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` ≈L340–L356) may also say what it needs. That part is optional: the triage grade asks for the control.

### Scope

File surface: `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` (+ `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` only if the picker line is added) + i18n rows for the control + tests: authoring `kind` on a select's options writes it, and the object then saves with that field as `stageField` (parse through the spec's `ObjectSchema` / `FieldSchema`); clearing it removes the key; a multi-select or non-select field shows no control and never writes `kind`; an existing `kind` round-trips. Ablation: drop the control's write ⇒ the new tests go red. ⛔ No spec or engine change.

i18n home: new strings for the option editor belong with the `designer.field.*` family, which lives in the lazy `studio` namespace (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`) since #26593; a zh test preloads with `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`. ⛔ Add no `engine.studio.settings.*` row: #25922 S4 (this seat, in flight) is moving that family now. If the picker needs a line, take its key from `designer.field.*` too.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `high` (M). `Clause-②: no` (Studio now authors a key the spec already publishes and the engine already enforces), `Metadata-protocol: none` expected; say otherwise if the diff shows it. Patch changeset for `@object-ui/i18n` if you add namespace rows (it is published); none for app-shell (`private: true`).
